content.text:
The settings page refuses another outgoing webhook when the endpoint count is already at the plan quota. That quota is the `webhooks` field on each plan in `PLAN_LIMITS`.

ANSWER: src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/webhooks/page.tsx, src/config/plan-limits.ts
